title: My Journey
text:
About
      My Journey
      What keeps pulling me into analytics is the moment a pattern starts explaining a decision. Before I had the formal language for it, I was already doing that work in commercial roles, watching customer behaviour, revenue movement and team performance closely enough to ask, “What is this really telling us?”
    

    

      
        
        
          Business Development Leader
          FCA-regulated fintech
          At TigerWit, I used customer and conversion data to drive revenue decisions in an FCA-regulated fintech environment, generating £300k to £600k in monthly revenue against a £75k target. I learned that the most valuable insights are not the numbers themselves, they are the reasons behind them.
        
      

      
        
        
          Business Analytics
          MSc, Bournemouth University · Merit
          That is why I studied Business Analytics: to put stronger technical methods behind the judgement I had built in practice.
        
      

      
        
        
          Data Analyst 7+ years in data-driven roles
          SQL · Power BI · R · Business intelligence
          Now I use SQL, Power BI, R and business intelligence to build clearer answers from customer, revenue and workforce data, including my WERS workforce analytics project (21,981 survey responses).
        
      

    

  

  
      The work I enjoy most sits in that middle space: listening to what the business is struggling with, finding the evidence underneath it, and turning it into something people can actually use.

      
        
          Customer Intelligence
          Segmentation, churn, lifecycle and conversion.
        
        
          Commercial Analytics
          Revenue, campaign ROI, pipeline and affiliate performance.
        
        
          SQL & Validation
          SQL validation, reconciliation and migration controls, supporting 99.9% post-migration data integrity and reducing migration exceptions by 36%.
        
        
          Power BI & DAX
          Dashboards, star schema models and validated MI outputs.
        
        
          R & Statistical Modelling
          Regression, decision-tree modelling, tidyverse and ggplot2.
        
        
          Workforce & People Data
          Survey analytics, retention modelling and reward analysis.
